items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: I'm going with Mr. Thelonius Monk... I want you to join my band... I was still with Thelonius when we was at, when I quit Thelonius

ctx.x: So when I was down there, checking in at home, and uh, and they said a man called here named Thelonius Monk, for you. We told him that you would be back next week, and he said get in touch with him as soon as you get back. I say Thank Goodness, I will. I'm jumping out of the frying pan into the pot now. I'm going with Mr. Thelonius Monk, I didn't know this man was-out,you know.
